verdict.rationale: LegalZoom's registered-agent service says you get an alert as soon as official mail arrives. It also says documents are scanned and uploaded to your account, with an email notification, follow-up reminders if you don't open it, and a postcard. That is an immediate per-item notification rather than a batched mail digest. missing for 10: explicit mention of service-of-process or lawsuit handling as a priority category, a stated delivery-time SLA, urgent channels beyond email (SMS or phone), and independent or hands-on corroboration that alerts are actually immediate.
